package.name: follower
package.description:
Follower ROS 功能包 — 目标跟随控制器。
接收 Tracker 功能包输出的归一化跟踪误差，通过 PID + 自适应算法 计算出 PX4-Autopilot 可用的控制速度指令（body velocity / yaw rate）。
MRS-style ROS package for target following control. Receives normalized tracking errors from the Tracker package, computes body-velocity + yaw-rate control commands via PID and adaptive algorithms, compatible with PX4-Autopilot Offboard mode and Gazebo SITL.
Data flow: Tracker → Follower → Controller (预留端口)
package.author: Follower Team
